summary: 3D arcade driving game with a yellow shared minibus in a low-poly Istanbul neighbourhood, built by Claude Sonnet 5.5 · Alçak poligon bir İstanbul mahallesinde sarı dolmuşla 3D arcade sürüş, Claude Sonnet 5.5 yaptı
key_features: Stop, open the door and pick up waving passengers; each one names their stop in a chat bubble, 12 seats
v2: a 3-2-1 start and a coached first stop with a pulsing ring and an arrow instead of a blocking intro screen
v2: from level 2 some riders just want to be dropped anywhere safe near their stop; the minimap marks them with a ? and crossings and junctions are refused
v2: fares hop forward along the occupied seats (the fare chain) and the shift summary names your two costliest mistakes with a tip
Eight shifts and an endless mode with a tram, rain, a VIP passenger, a traffic jam and a night shift, with district looks, rain umbrellas and lit windows at night
The ?auto bot finished all 8 levels with the same controls and rules as a player; one index.html, optional CC0 asset pass

social.headline: Drive a yellow dolmuş through Istanbul: pick up passengers, learn their stops, earn fares and tips · Sarı dolmuşla İstanbul'da yolcu al, durağını öğren, ücret ve bahşiş topla

provenance.rule: mechanical fields read from the repository; editorial fields hand-written from the README, index.html, docs/assets.md and the video-studio analiz.md; no field is generated from a guess
